item.title: Oliver Tree Memorial Service to Be Livestreamed on July 25
item.description:
[Ethereal music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: Welcome to this special segment of our podcast, where we remember the life and legacy of Oliver Tree, a talented artist who left us far too soon. On June 14, Oliver Tree tragically passed away in a helicopter crash in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, alongside five others.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: A memorial service and celebration of life has been scheduled for July 25 at the UCSC Quarry Amphitheater in Santa Cruz, California. Due to limited space, the event will be livestreamed for the public, with details on how to watch coming soon.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of Oliver Tree's song]
Host: Oliver Tree, born Oliver Tree Nickell, was just 32 years old when he passed away. He was on his World's First World Tour, traveling through South America, and had just performed his final live show in São Paulo on June 6. His fourth studio album, Love You Madly Hate You Badly, was released in April via Atlantic Records.
[Music fades back to the host]
Host: Oliver's family has shared a beautiful obituary, remembering him as "more than a musician; he was a true artist in every sense of the word." They describe him as someone who "cared so deeply about spreading art, joy, laughter, and love into the world" and wanted to create an inclusive environment where everyone belonged.
[Soft music continues to play]
Host: Oliver Tree's musical accomplishments are undeniable. His debut major-label album, Ugly Is Beautiful, topped the Billboard Top Rock & Alternative Albums chart in 2020. He also collaborated with Robin Schulz on the song "Miss You," which reached number 4 on the Hot Dance/Electronic Songs chart in 2022.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of "Life Goes On"]
Host: Oliver's family has requested that donations be made in his honor to the Dr. Oliver Tree's Extremely Epic Art Grant for Baby Geniuses foundation, which he had outlined in his will. The foundation aims to support young artists in pursuing their dreams, providing grants for music, film, installation, and performance art.
[Music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: If you'd like to learn more about the foundation or make a donation, you can visit olivertreefoundation.com. We'll be sure to share the details on how to watch the memorial service livestream as soon as they become available.
[Soft music fades back in, and the host concludes]
Host: That's all for today's special segment. We remember Oliver Tree as a talented artist, a true original, and a kind soul who left an indelible mark on the world. Rest in peace, Oliver.
